レバー入りタコライス
Okinawan taco rice: white rice on a plate topped with seasoned minced meat mixed with small pieces of sauteed chicken liver, shredded lettuce, diced tomato and shredded cheese.
さばキーマ
keema curry made with flaked mackerel (clearly visible flakes of mackerel fish instead of minced meat) cooked with onion and tomato, served on a plate next to white rice.
かますの干物のから揚げ
bite-size pieces of dried barracuda (kamasu himono, silver skin partly visible) coated in starch and deep-fried karaage style until crisp, on a plate with a lemon wedge.
はもの焼き物

grilled pike conger (hamo), a Kyoto dish: white fish fillets with many fine parallel knife cuts (honegiri), brushed with soy glaze and grilled until golden brown, served on a plate with a pickled ginger shoot.
半助豆腐
hansuke-dofu, an Osaka dish: grilled eel heads (dark glossy kabayaki-style eel heads) simmered with large pieces of grilled tofu and green onions in a sweet soy broth, in a shallow bowl.
焼きなすとかつおのおろしポン酢
slices of seared bonito (katsuo tataki, red inside with seared edges) arranged with grilled peeled eggplant, topped with grated daikon radish and chopped green onion, with ponzu sauce.
野菜のカツ煮
sliced breaded pork cutlet simmered with onion, carrot and green vegetables in dashi broth and bound with soft egg, in a shallow dish.
豚肉としめじのカレーマヨ炒め
stir-fried thin pork slices and shimeji mushrooms coated in a yellowish curry-mayonnaise sauce, on a plate. No noodles.
くるみ豆腐

kurumi-dofu, an Iwate dish: a smooth, glossy, pale beige square block similar to sesame tofu, made from ground walnuts set with kudzu starch (it is NOT soybean tofu and has no toppings of nuts or beans), served on a small plate with shredded daikon radish beside it and a small spoonful of sweet ginger miso sauce on top.
冬瓜のサラダ
salad of thinly sliced winter melon (pale translucent white-green half-moon slices) lightly dressed, with a little dried bonito flakes on top.
ミルファンティ

mille fanti, an Italian egg drop soup: clear chicken broth filled with fine fluffy curds made of egg mixed with breadcrumbs and grated cheese, sprinkled with chopped parsley, in a soup bowl. No bread on top, no melted cheese crust.
きびだんご鍋

an Okayama hot pot in an earthenware pot with three kinds of round dumplings (chicken meatballs, pink shrimp balls and small white shiratama rice dumplings), chicken pieces, cabbage, carrot, mizuna greens and shiitake mushrooms in clear broth.
とうへい鍋

tohei-nabe, a Fukuoka fisherman's hot pot: miso-based broth in an earthenware pot with chunks of conger eel (white flesh with dark skin), cabbage, shiitake, shimeji, enoki mushrooms, green onion and tofu.
くるみ豆腐 (2)

kurumi-dofu, an Iwate dish: two smooth, glossy, pale beige rectangular slices similar to sesame tofu, made from ground walnuts set with kudzu starch (NOT soybean tofu, no nuts or beans on top), on a small dark plate with a little shredded daikon and a dab of sweet miso sauce.
とうへい鍋 (2)
a Fukuoka fisherman's hot pot seen from above: brown miso broth in an earthenware pot with thick pieces of conger eel (white flesh, dark gray skin), cabbage, tofu, green onion and mushrooms.
半助豆腐 (2)

an Osaka home dish in a small pot: two or three grilled eel heads (dark glossy, kabayaki glazed) simmered with blocks of grilled tofu with brown grill marks and cut green onions in a dark sweet soy broth.
はもの焼き物 (2)
a Kyoto dish: two pieces of pike conger (hamo) grilled with a sweet soy glaze (teriyaki style), golden brown and glossy, the flesh showing many fine parallel cuts, on a rectangular plate.
ミッレファンティ (2)
Italian egg drop soup in a white soup bowl: light golden broth with many small fluffy curds of egg, cheese and breadcrumbs floating evenly, a little parsley. No bread slices, no gratin.
